memory_bridge: Turn the five-point shape into a May picnic: 五月 on the invitation supplies On ゴ, while five rice balls counted at the picnic are 五つ for Kun いつつ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 五月（ごがつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Pin 五月（ごがつ） to the five-point calendar as the May page; its opening sound fixes On ゴ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 五つ（いつつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Place a rice ball at each of the five built-in points and count 五つ（いつつ）; the complete native counter fixes Kun いつつ, “five.”
